name: BenchHub
description: BenchHub is a dynamic benchmark repository aggregating and classifying benchmark datasets from diverse domains, integrating 303K questions across 38 benchmarks. It supports continuous updates and customizable evaluation tailored to various domains or use cases, enabling more effective and domain-aware LLM evaluation.
typical_sota_score: varies widely across included sub-benchmarks; no single consolidated SOTA
reputation: A new benchmark repository aimed at organizing and continuously updating many existing benchmarks, but it is not yet a standard community benchmark in its own right.
notes: Aggregates 38 benchmarks and supports flexible, domain-specific evaluation; emphasizes domain-aware benchmarking.
